statement: UBS projects hyperscalers will deploy about $4.1 trillion on AI infrastructure from 2026 to 2028, roughly tripling the $1.3 trillion spent over the prior six years.
why: Hyperscaler capital spending is the single largest source of merchant-GPU demand, so a tripling of the multi-year budget sets the ceiling for accelerator, networking and datacenter orders.

impact.mechanism: Committed multi-year AI infrastructure budgets convert into purchase orders for GPUs, servers, network fabric and the power/space to host them.

evidence.excerpt: $4.1 trillion on AI infrastructure from 2026 to 2028
triples the $1.3 trillion deployed over the previous six years

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet relaying a third-party analyst projection; no filing or vendor guidance corroboration.

entity: Hyperscalers (Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, Meta, SpaceX, Oracle) / UBS estimate
